# Vendor Libraries

This directory holds third-party JavaScript libraries used by the project.
The actual minified source files are not bundled here due to environment
limitations. Download the correct versions and place them in this folder:

- `jspdf.umd.min.js` v2.5.1 from <https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/jspdf/2.5.1/jspdf.umd.min.js>
- `html2canvas.min.js` v1.4.1 from <https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/html2canvas/1.4.1/html2canvas.min.js>
- `docx.umd.min.js` v7.5.0 from <https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/docx/7.5.0/docx.umd.min.js>

Replace the placeholder files in this directory with the real libraries to
enable export features.
